description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring squared tapering pyramid with four triangular lid flaps around the opening.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：方形渐细锥体，开口周围有四片三角盖。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is squared tapering pyramid with four triangular lid flaps around the opening; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以方形渐细锥体，开口周围有四片三角盖为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish squared tapering pyramid with four triangular lid flaps around the opening in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以方形渐细锥体，开口周围有四片三角盖搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Pyramidal multi-lid rugose coral; verify species-specific lid count and closure. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Structural-functional aspects in the evolution of operculate corals (Rugosa)
sources.supports: Calceola slipper shape and single operculum; Goniophyllum pyramidal shape and multiple lids; reconstructed soft bodies are hypotheses.
